neighbours.label: a back-reference to something already seen happening again ('again', 'that kind of ... again'); matched sentences with no repetition stay low
fire: She won the title in 2015 but never reached that kind of level again.
Close your eyes and imagine it again: the waves, the wind, the salt.
I will repeat it again: always wear a helmet on the bike.
The band never played that kind of show again after the tour.
Read the first line again and notice how short it is.
He never found that kind of happiness again after the war.
Think about it again before you sign the contract.
We tried the recipe again, and this time the bread rose.
quiet: She won the title in 2015 and stayed near the top for years.
Close your eyes and listen to the waves, the wind and the gulls.
Always wear a helmet when you ride the bike to school.
The band played a long show in Berlin at the end of the tour.
Read the first line and notice how short it is.
He found great happiness with his family after the war.
Think carefully before you sign the contract.
We tried a new recipe, and the bread rose nicely.
